scenes.name: last-pool
scenes.prompt: An immense ivory nautilus shell lies half buried in a vast cracked terracotta desert beneath an ink-blue dusk sky. The shell is a sculpted vessel tilted toward us, its open chamber containing the last pool of luminous turquoise water. A small vermilion wooden boat rests on this pool, carrying a single round glowing pearl in its hull. A narrow silver-blue stream escapes the shell toward the lower right and winds far across the dry landscape. On the distant horizon stands one enormous closed ivory flower bud. The shell occupies the left half, the red boat is clearly readable near the middle, and the right half opens into spacious desert and twilight. An exquisite surrealist oil painting with dimensional carved ivory, jewel-colored enamel, deep velvet shadows, warm copper earth, delicate engraved textures and precise luminous highlights. Monumental distinct silhouettes, tactile detail, poetic dream logic and generous negative space.

prompt_schedule.name: a-light-under-the-bridge
prompt_schedule.prompt: Under an ivory bridge in a submerged city, a luminous round pearl hangs above still deep-blue water. A tiny red boat rests on the bridge high above it. The dark arched opening around the pearl draws us into the sleeping city, whose narrow windows glow amber. Golden roots wind around the stone columns. An exquisite dimensional surrealist oil painting, deep ultramarine and luminous turquoise, pearlescent ivory, warm copper and a small vermilion accent. Tactile carved surfaces, crisp engraved detail, luminous reflected light and deep velvet shadows. Monumental readable silhouettes, generous open space and poetic dream logic.

prompt_schedule.name: the-city-listens
prompt_schedule.prompt: The luminous pearl grows brighter beneath the central ivory arch of a sleeping underwater city. A delicate transparent glass dome is forming around it like a bell, with a thin golden rim. Amber light spreads into a few nearby windows. The foreground opens around the single suspended light, and carved stone buildings recede into blue distance. An exquisite dimensional surrealist oil painting, deep ultramarine and luminous turquoise, pearlescent ivory, warm copper and a small vermilion accent. A small red boat silhouette remains far away along an ivory bridge, and the surrounding water is spacious and dark.
